summary: DueByte 0.3.66 adds bounded production issuance for an explicitly signed terminal zero-stage plan, capped at 10,000 DUBYT inclusive: 9,000 warmup, 900 early founder award and 100 collateral support. Full fund issuance and century subsidy remain disabled. Validator and recipient signatures, exact amounts, admission, replay protection and UTC limits remain mandatory. Installing this release does not issue tokens or activate warmup or exchange. Existing chain, wallet keys, balances and signing history are retained. Home65 updates automatically; Linux Server requires coordinated manual installation. Windows executable is not Microsoft-code-signed; verify the signed DueByte channel. The candidate notice inside the immutable archive is superseded by this release notice.
